title: SE+ Shoreline Extractor: lidar-constrained shoreline extraction for mixed marsh and non-marsh coasts (ArcGIS Pro toolbox)
description: An ArcGIS Pro Python toolbox that extracts shorelines from multispectral imagery (MNDWI with Otsu thresholding) and, optionally, constrains the land– water decision with a bare-earth lidar DEM referenced to Mean High Water (MHW). Elevation assigns each pixel to clearly land, clearly water, or near MHW; vegetated ground near MHW is identified as marsh (NDVI). Shoreline segments are labelled marsh or non-marsh, and the non-marsh shoreline and the marsh shoreline are delivered as separate layers, with a segmentation map (open water, inland water, land, marsh) and diagnostic rasters. Developed for coastal Louisiana using Sentinel-2 imagery and NOAA lidar.
